stem:
Meena and her friend Arjun want to measure the length of their classroom so that both of them get the same result. Meena suggests four different ways to measure it.
Which way is suitable as a standard unit for shared measurements?

options.text: Measuring with Meena's handspan, because it is easy to use
Measuring with Arjun's footstep, because he walks carefully
Measuring in metres using a metre scale, because the metre is an SI unit
Measuring with a stick of any length found near the classroom

teacher.key_rationale: A standard unit must give the same result for everyone; only the metre (SI unit) satisfies this. Handspans, footsteps and random sticks vary from person to person, so A, B and D are unsuitable. Key: C.
